answer: Proof of stake serves as a robust defense for AI economies by anchoring identity to capital rather than ephemeral compute. An attacker attempting to inflate their influence faces a downward spiral of declining yields as the cost of collateral exceeds marginal gains. This mechanism transforms the network into a secure haven where validator trust relies on staked assets akin to the immutable structure of a quartz crystal, forcing any Sybil actor to internalize the full financial burden of their own subversion.
